network.tdh.hero.title: TDH
network.tdh.hero.intro: TDH (Total Days Held) is our time-weighted holding metric. Each NFT you hold contributes its days-held to your total. We then multiply by edition-size weights and apply collection "boosters" based on what you hold.
network.tdh.how.title: How TDH is computed
network.tdh.how.unweighted.title: Unweighted days:
network.tdh.how.unweighted.body: each NFT contributes 1 per day it's held.
network.tdh.how.edition.title: Edition weighting:
network.tdh.how.edition.body: we scale by edition size with FirstGM ({editionSize}) as 1.
network.tdh.how.boosters.title: Boosts:
network.tdh.how.boosters.body: we multiply by the higher of Category A or B, then add Category C. (Details below.)
network.tdh.current.title: TDH 1.4 ({date} — present)
network.tdh.current.intro: Higher of Category A and Category B boosters, plus Category C boosters.

network.tdhHistoric.hero.title: Historic boosts
network.tdhHistoric.hero.intro: Every boost schedule 6529.io has used, the current one first. Current boosts on the overview shows today’s values.
network.tdhHistoric.hero.v1: Boost schedules 1.1 to 1.4 are 6529.io’s versions of the boost. TDH-v1 (rule version tdh-v1.0) restates the live rule, schedule 1.4, exactly, from the backend’s code, and the daily comparison checks only that schedule.

network.tdhHistoric.timeline.note: With extra full sets and Gradients, today’s highest boost is 2.04×, and the schedule’s highest 2.24× once seasons 1 to 20 pay; the four figures are drawn together below the table.
network.tdhHistoric.provenance: Where these values come from: schedules 1.1 to 1.3 are as 6529.io has published them on its TDH pages, which live in the public 6529seize-frontend repository (this archive since October 9, 2025); schedule 1.4 is the backend’s current rule file, src/tdhLoop/tdh-rules.ts in the public 6529seize-backend repository, which P26 cites line by line. Days under schedules 1.1 to 1.3 are not checked: the daily comparison starts on October 14, 2026, under 1.4, and before November 14, 2024 6529.io’s snapshots were often taken hours before midnight, so those days cannot be reproduced under TDH-v1’s snapshot rule.
